page.description: Red Hat Enterprise Linux: what it is, who it is for, and where to get it from Red Hat.
page.intro: Red Hat's commercial enterprise Linux, the distribution that CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux rebuild. Red Hat publishes the media and the support terms; ROMinit does not pin an image for it.
pros: Ten-year life cycles per major release, with defined maintenance phases.
Certified hardware, ISV software and cloud images in one subscription.
Upstream of CentOS Stream, so fixes arrive here after they stabilise.
Support, training and errata come from one vendor.
cons: Needs a Red Hat subscription for updates and support.
No free public download without a Red Hat account.
Media and rebuilds differ: this page is a signpost, not a pinned image.
Red Hat's own pages state the life-cycle dates; none is repeated here.
page.previewNote: Information-only page: Red Hat supplies the media and ROMinit does not pin or test an image here.
page.status: Red Hat publishes and supports its own media. This page only points at Red Hat's product and life-cycle pages; there is nothing to download from ROMinit and no USB path.
